scope: Collection routes and blank-record specification only. No participant, legal determination, external sending or guide change.

counting_rules.rule: Separate introduced, verified, accepted, scheduled, completed, usable and publication-cleared states.
Count a person once for the report across multiple modes/sessions/roles, after eligibility, actual usable input and permitted analysis use are established.
A buyer is not automatically a senior employer-side payroll practitioner.
A council prospect can overlap only with eligibility, actual report-relevant input and the relevant permission. RSVP/question suggestion alone is not a full report contribution.
One combined session is one Table conversation event even if two roles are covered; multiple actual Table sessions remain multiple events but one person.
Separate question-specific usable/publication bases from distinct-contributor counts; no fixed answered-question threshold or representative percentage.
No introductions, no replies or scheduled slots counted as completed input. No public source/AI answer substituted for an absent original contributor.

routes.rule: Confirm qualifying recent event/direct involvement; use selective case probes, preserving event/programme dates.
Only never-raised need is pre-proposal; if qualifying case emerges, confirm and resume recent-case route.
Useful operating/priorities input may remain; do not invent approval/transaction.
Keep older/uncertain account separately labelled; substantive recent event inside older programme can qualify only when established.
Stop declined request; participant may choose to continue a remaining permitted route. No repeated pressure.
Same guide/version with relevant selected coverage; no guarantee all items answered or equivalent depth.
Disclose commercial feasibility purpose; unaided real need/alternatives before proposition; interest is not commitment.
Proposed council not booked event or membership; relevant report overlap separately established.

prepare_now: Participant information draft with unresolved fields
before_collection_dependencies: User permission before any external sending
Client focus/population/guide and introduction route review
Final participant information and permission/change/release process
Appropriate processing/access/transfer arrangements as determined by responsible parties
